title: Atlas project docket — Dkt. 1 is the Goal; 1-x are projects; INDEX Dkt. 1 is preserved until adopted migration
issue_presented: How should Atlas represent the universal Goal as Dkt. 1 when Governance INDEX docket_no 1 is already occupied by O-V2-001, without rewriting history or creating a competing source of law?

known_facts.fact: INDEX.json docket_no 1 is Order O-V2-001, filed_utc 2026-08-23T21:08:06+00:00, source_path law/orders/O-V2-001.md.
User instruction 2026-08-24 requires Dkt. 1 GOAL with an exact immutable sentence, projects 1-1…1-N, one Atlas docket, and no silent overwrite or renumber of the existing Dkt. 1.
The Goal sentence was filed at law/goal/DKT_1_GOAL.json with hash 495c6a3e2f49cc1af70e87b34a81e3505822e57c447024c338fb050e7d5b4847.

unknown_or_disputed_facts.fact: Whether the human Viewer landing page (/human) should display the project docket or the Governance INDEX after this Judgment is adopted.

analysis: See A-J-0014 (layer without rewrite) and CA-J-0014 (dual Dkt. 1 is unsafe). This proposed Judgment does not silently adopt either. It is not ACTIVE.
judgment_rule: PROPOSED Holding 1 — The universal Atlas Goal is the exact sentence stored in law/goal/DKT_1_GOAL.json. It must not be silently edited. A later change is a new filing (AMENDED GOAL) plus a pointer move.
PROPOSED Holding 2 — CURRENT_OPERATIVE_GOAL initially resolves to DKT_1.
PROPOSED Holding 3 — Projects under that Goal are 1-1, 1-2, … 1-N. Identifiers are stable and never reused for a different project.
PROPOSED Holding 4 — Until a user-adopted migration Order, viewer/docket/INDEX.json docket_no 1 remains O-V2-001. Agents citing Dkt. 1 must name the series: ATLAS_PROJECT_DOCKET or GOVERNANCE_INDEX.
PROPOSED Holding 5 — Task 12 workflow treats ATLAS_PROJECT_DOCKET Dkt. 1 as the root. Space Investment Research is project 1-1.
PROPOSED Holding 6 — This Judgment is not law while status is PROPOSED.
operational_effect: Operational architecture implemented without adoption: docket/ATLAS_DOCKET.json is the current Atlas docket; INDEX is LEGACY_HISTORICAL_INDEX with frozen identities 1–87 and alias LEGACY_GOV_V2_DKT_1 for O-V2-001. This Judgment remains PROPOSED and is not law. Human Atlas docket is /atlas. / and /human display the legacy INDEX labeled as historical.
exceptions: Does not authorize redocketing INDEX. Does not rewrite Task 7/8, Hunter, or Atlas-Math. Does not close the Space Complaint when a task closes.
required_validation: Exact Goal sentence and hash; INDEX docket_no 1 still O-V2-001; CURRENT_OPERATIVE_GOAL=DKT_1; project 1-1 exists; J-0014 remains PROPOSED until user adoption.

provenance.adoption: NOT ADOPTED. Proposed only. No Reply stage.
